item_short_desc: Elevate your outdoor space with our 6' Steel Flag Pole, designed to showcase your patriotism with pride. This 2-section flag pole is crafted from durable steel, ensuring long-lasting performance and resilience against the elements. The crowning glory is an elegant American Eagle ornament, symbolizing strength and freedom.
